project.name: Private Archive
project.audience: One owner curating a private photo, video, and file history
project.primaryGoal: Save media once and reliably rediscover it from a calm searchable timeline

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 plus project tokens

design.direction: Quiet warm archival editorial interface: mineral paper, graphite type, restrained olive accents, photographic contact sheets, film-index marks, museum-archive spacing, image-first layouts, and a dark viewing room
design.signature: Home Archive Composition: a CSS/DOM contact-sheet cover with three flat photographic frames, registration marks, accession labels, date/index typography, and optional non-blocking real previews. Never a globe, orbit, celestial object, heavy 3D hero, or dashboard card wall.

routes.purpose: Chronological media archive and personal archive cover
Recently added and recently viewed assets
Items intentionally removed from the daily timeline
Recoverable deleted items with source and deletion metadata
Archive, storage, trash, connection, and advanced diagnostics settings
